cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?
